name: webhook-lead-capture
description: Receive a website lead (e.g. from an OpenClaw webhook), validate and clean it, skip duplicates, append it to a CSV file, and notify the team.

payload.default: {"name": "  Ada Lovelace ", "email": "ADA@Example.com", "company": "Analytical Engines Ltd", "message": "We would like a demo for 20 people."}
payload.description: The lead as a JSON string: name, email, company (optional), message (optional)

leads_file.description: CSV file the leads are appended to (created if missing)

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for new-lead alerts (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: node -e 'let raw; try { raw = JSON.parse(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_PAYLOAD) } catch (e) { raw = null } const errors = []; if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") errors.push("payload is not a JSON object"); raw = raw || {}; const clean = s => String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 500); const lead = { name: clean(raw.name), email: clean(raw.email).toLowerCase(), company: clean(raw.company), message: clean(raw.message) }; if (!lead.name) errors.push("name is missing"); if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/.test(lead.email)) errors.push("email is not valid"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ valid: errors.length === 0, errors, lead }))'

node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_LEADS_FILE.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const lead = JSON.parse(process.env.LEAD); const csv = v => /[",
]/.test(v) ? """ + v.replace(/"/g, """") + """ : v; const header = "received_at,name,email,company,message"; const existing = fs.existsSync(file) ? fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8") : ""; const emails = existing.split("
").slice(1).map(l => (l.match(/^[^,]*,(?:"(?:[^"]|"")*"|[^,]*),([^,]*)/) || [])[1]).filter(Boolean); if (emails.includes(lead.email)) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ added: false, reason: "duplicate", lead, file })); process.exit(0) } fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); const row = [new Date().toISOString(), lead.name, lead.email, lead.company, lead.message].map(csv).join(","); fs.writeFileSync(file, (existing ? existing.replace(/
?$/, "
") : header + "
") + row + "
"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ added: true, total: emails.length + 1, lead, file }))'
node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(process.env.RESULT); console.log("❌ Lead rejected: " + r.errors.join(", "))'
printf 'Duplicate lead ignored: %s is already in the list.\n' "$EMAIL"

MSG=$(node -e 'const r = JSON.parse(process.env.RESULT); const l = r.lead; console.log("🆕 New lead #" + r.total + ": " + l.name + " <" + l.email + ">" + (l.company ? " from " + l.company : "") + (l.message ? "\n💬 " + l.message : ""))'); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
